violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §747.4401(2))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: Two year old children were observed using a dome climber play equipment that is for ages 3-10 years of age.

finding_variants.text: Two year old children were observed using a dome climber play equipment that is for ages 3-10 years of age.
The rock climber present on the playground is recommended for children ages 4-8 years old according to the manufacturer's instructions.

The netting around the small trampoline in the playroom had rips and tears in it. This was corrected when the entrance of the trampoline net was turned to be facing a corner and not accessible to children. The primary caregiver will take the trampoline apart to remove it.
The operator had installed two play structures and did not have manufacturer's instructions for either structure, making it impossible to assess if they were being used as intended.
Play equipment was not installed per manufacturer instructions. The manufacturer instructions requires 6 1/2 feet around the entire equipment, which was not met.
An infant booster seat intended for use on the floor or strapped to a chair was placed on top of a table.
